BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Songs of Experience

The Fly

L
ITTLE
 Fly,
Thy summer’s play
My thoughtless hand
Has brush’d away.
Am not I
A fly like thee?
Or art not thou
A man like me?
For I dance,
And drink, and sing,
Till some blind hand
Shall brush my wing.
If thought is life
And strength and breath,
And the want
Of thought is death;
Then am I
A happy fly,
If I live
Or if I die.
